msg: I never really got a good grasp of what was going on do I am not sure that I can provide any useful advice, and if you can work out something for yourself then I think you should go with that.  I definitely got the sense that at some points one of the gnomes in each pair was doing better than the other one but that this switched at various points during the game.  However, I was never confident of this and I wasn't sure if I correctly realised when they switched.  It might be useful at the start to know that the number of mushrooms seems to range between 0 and 9, and I ended up with about 1050, if that helps to judge what is going on in the early stages of the game.
